literal: Yang Fei; Lu Qian; Cui Jie; Lu Shuowu; Yang Xiuzhi; Yuan Yuxiu (陽斐 盧潛 崔劼 盧叔武 陽休之 袁聿修)
idiomatic: Yang Fei; Lu Qian; Cui Jie; Lu Shuowu; Yang Xiuzhi; Yuan Yuxiu

literal: Yang Fei, styled Shuluan, was a man of Yuyang in Beiping.
idiomatic: Yang Fei, styled Shuluan, came from Yuyang in Beiping.

literal: His father Zao was Wei administrator of Jiande; posthumously enfeoffed as inspector of Youzhou.
idiomatic: His father Zao had been Wei administrator of Jiande and was posthumously enfeoffed as inspector of Youzhou.

literal: In the Xiaozhuang era, Fei had merit supervising displaced populations in Western Yan and was enfeoffed as Baron of Fangcheng.
idiomatic: Under Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei, Fei had merit supervising displaced populations in Western Yan and was enfeoffed as baron of Fangcheng.

literal: He served in succession as attendant censor, concurrently director of the office for capital cases, establishment-office middle aide to Prince of Guangping, and compiler of the Daily Records.
idiomatic: He served in succession as attendant censor, concurrently as director of the office for capital cases and middle aide in Prince of Guangping's establishment office, and as compiler of the Daily Records.

literal: In the Xinghe era he was made director of the ministry of appointments, concurrently regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, and sent on embassy to Liang.
idiomatic: In the Xinghe era he was made director of the ministry of appointments, concurrently regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, and sent on embassy to Liang.

literal: Liang Minister of Writing Yang Kan was a Wei defector who had old ties with Fei and wished to invite Fei to his house; he sent three letters, and Fei did not reply.
idiomatic: Liang minister of writing Yang Kan was a Wei defector with old ties to Fei and wished to invite him to his house. He sent three letters; Fei did not reply.

literal: The Liang people said: "Yang has been here a long time, and through your noble dynasty's changes Li and Lu also called at his house to meet him—why do you make it difficult?
idiomatic: The Liang people said, "Yang has been here a long time. Through your noble dynasty's changes, Li and Lu also called at his house—why do you make it difficult?

literal: " Fei said: "What Lianghui did, he might do; I may not.
idiomatic: " Fei said, "What Lianghui did, he might do; I may not.

literal: " The Liang ruler then personally told Fei: "Yang Kan ardently wishes to meet you. Now the two states are on good terms and all under Heaven is one family—how can we again speak of this side and that?
idiomatic: " The Liang ruler then told Fei in person, "Yang Kan ardently wishes to meet you. Now the two states are on good terms and all under Heaven is one family—how can we again speak of this side and that?

literal: " In the end Fei declined.
idiomatic: " In the end Fei declined.

literal: When the mission returned he was made vice director of the court of justice.
idiomatic: When the mission returned he was made vice director of the court of justice.

literal: The Stone Ford River overflowed and the bridge was ruined; Fei repaired it.
idiomatic: The Stone Ford River overflowed and the bridge was ruined; Fei repaired it.

literal: He also moved the ford to White Horse, raised stone weirs in mid-river, and built pass-cities on both banks—a project of many years before it was finished.
idiomatic: He also moved the ford to White Horse, raised stone weirs in mid-river, and built pass-cities on both banks. The work took many years to finish.

literal: Administrator of Dong commandery Lu Shipei, because Liyang Pass and the river terrain were strategically strong, wished to follow the mountains and ravines to make a public park and hunting preserve.
idiomatic: Lu Shipei, administrator of Dong commandery, because Liyang Pass and the river terrain were strategically strong, wished to follow the mountains and ravines and make a public park and hunting preserve.

literal: He sent Fei a letter saying: "I shall consult the Grand General and make you the craftsman."
idiomatic: He sent Fei a letter saying, "I shall consult the grand general and make you the craftsman."

literal: Fei answered refusing: "At present deep sorrow has awakened a sage, and fortune meets a flourishing age.
idiomatic: Fei answered in refusal: "At present deep sorrow has awakened a sage, and fortune meets a flourishing age.

literal: Hence the late Grand Chancellor, Heaven opening his hegemonic achievement, remade the Supreme Ultimate;
idiomatic: Hence the late grand chancellor Gao Huan, Heaven opening his hegemonic achievement, remade the supreme pole;

literal: the Grand General, light inheriting the prior structure, continuing the great enterprise manifestly bright.
idiomatic: the grand general Gao Cheng, light inheriting the prior structure, continuing the great enterprise in manifest brightness.

literal: The state's steps have just grown secure and the people's toil is not yet eased—truly one ought to lighten corvée and reduce levies and diligently tend the people's hardships.
idiomatic: The state's steps have just grown secure and the people's toil is not yet eased—truly one ought to lighten corvée, reduce levies, and diligently tend the people's hardships.

literal: Does not the Odes say: 'The people also are weary; they may have a little rest—show favor to these central lands and thereby pacify the four quarters.'
idiomatic: Does not the Odes say, 'The people also are weary; they may have a little rest—show favor to these central lands and thereby pacify the four quarters.'

literal: The ancient emperors also had times when they marked out mountains and carved trees, yet that fell short of fulfilling their intent;
idiomatic: The ancient emperors also marked out mountains and carved trees, yet that fell short of fulfilling their intent;

literal: alighted from the chariot to hold a feast—how could that exhaust their feeling?
idiomatic: they alighted from the chariot to hold a feast—how could that exhaust their feeling?

literal: It only sufficed to waste Heaven-and-Earth's wealth and pare the living people's marrow and brain.
idiomatic: It only wasted Heaven-and-Earth's wealth and pared the living people's marrow and brain.

literal: Therefore Confucius answered Duke Ye of Chu on welcoming the distant and replied to Duke Ai of Lu on caring for the people—the questions were alike yet the urgent tasks differed.
idiomatic: Therefore Confucius answered Duke Ye of Chu on welcoming the distant and replied to Duke Ai of Lu on caring for the people—the questions were alike, yet the urgent tasks differed.

literal: Xiangru exalted the Shanglin spectacle, Yang Xiong deployed the feather-hunt rhetoric—though tied off with crumbling walls and filled dikes, and set among gathering nets and falling game—yet the words did not aid wind and teaching; they only enough declared their excess and fault."
idiomatic: Sima Xiangru exalted the Shanglin spectacle and Yang Xiong deployed the feather-hunt rhetoric—though tied off with crumbling walls and filled dikes, and set among gathering nets and falling game—the words did not aid wind and teaching; they only declared excess and fault."

literal: Lu Qian was a man of Zhuo in Fanyang.
idiomatic: Lu Qian came from Zhuo in Fanyang.

literal: His grandfather Shangzhi was Wei inspector of Ji province.
idiomatic: His grandfather Shangzhi was Wei inspector of Ji province.

literal: His father Wenfu was regular attendant for direct communication.
idiomatic: His father Wenfu was regular attendant for direct communication.

literal: Qian's appearance was striking and grand; he was skilled in conversation and from youth had the aspiration and bearing of a mature man.
idiomatic: Qian's appearance was striking and grand. He was skilled in conversation and from youth had the aspiration and bearing of a mature man.

literal: Palace Attendant Equal He Ba Sheng recruited him as expeditionary aide in the establishment office; he was made up as attendant censor.
idiomatic: Palace attendant equal He Ba Sheng recruited him as expeditionary aide in the establishment office; he was made up as attendant censor.

literal: Gao Cheng drew him in as western-pavilion libationer for the general-in-chief, transferred to middle military aide in the inner-and-outer office, strong and effective in confidential matters, known to Gao Cheng, who said he would in the end be greatly useful.
idiomatic: Gao Cheng drew him in as western-pavilion libationer for the general-in-chief and transferred him to middle military aide in the inner-and-outer office. He was strong and effective in confidential matters and came to Gao Cheng's notice; Gao Cheng said he would in the end be greatly useful.

literal: Wang Sizheng was captured at Yingchuan; Gao Cheng valued his talent and insight.
idiomatic: Wang Sizheng was captured at Yingchuan; Gao Cheng valued his talent and insight.

literal: Qian once at leisure told Gao Cheng: "Sizheng could not die defending principle—how is he worth esteeming!
idiomatic: Qian once told Gao Cheng at leisure, "Sizheng could not die defending principle—how is he worth esteeming!

literal: " Gao Cheng told those at his side: "With Lu Qian I have gained another Wang Sizheng."
idiomatic: " Gao Cheng told those at his side, "With Lu Qian I have gained another Wang Sizheng."

literal: Early in Tianbao he was made secretariat gentleman; for memorial matters offensive to the ruler's intent he was dismissed.
idiomatic: Early in Tianbao he was made secretariat gentleman; for memorial matters that offended the ruler's intent he was dismissed.

literal: Soon he was made left-director gentleman in the ministry of the people; for criticizing the Wei History he was confined together with Wang Songnian, Li Shu, and others.
idiomatic: Soon he was made left-director gentleman in the ministry of the people. For criticizing the Wei History he was confined together with Wang Songnian, Li Shu, and others.

literal: When Prince of Qinghe Yue was about to rescue Jiangling, Qian was specially amnestied and made Yue's mobile-staff aide.
idiomatic: When Prince of Qinghe Yue was about to rescue Jiangling, Qian was specially amnestied and made Yue's mobile-staff aide.

literal: On return he was moved to secretariat vice director; soon he was moved to vice director of the yellow gate.
idiomatic: On return he was moved to secretariat vice director; soon he was moved to vice director of the yellow gate.

literal: Yellow-gate gentleman Zheng Zimo memorialized that when Qian followed Prince of Qinghe on the southern campaign, the prince had Qian persuade Liang general Hou Tian, who took large bribes, and on return did not report it.
idiomatic: Yellow-gate gentleman Zheng Zimo memorialized that when Qian followed Prince of Qinghe on the southern campaign, the prince had Qian persuade Liang general Hou Tian, who took large bribes, and on return did not report it.

literal: Gao Yang caned Qian one hundred strokes, still cut off his beard, and demoted him to aide of the metropolitan magistrate of Wei.
idiomatic: Gao Yang caned Qian one hundred strokes, still cut off his beard, and demoted him to aide of the metropolitan magistrate of Wei.

literal: Soon he was made separate aide of the inspector of Si province, went out as inspector of Jiang province, and wherever he served had methods of governance.
idiomatic: Soon he was made separate aide of the inspector of Si province, then went out as inspector of Jiang province; wherever he served he had methods of governance.

literal: Gao Yan served as chancellor; Qian was made left aide on the Yangzhou circuit mobile staff.
idiomatic: When Gao Yan served as chancellor, Qian was made left aide on the Yangzhou circuit mobile staff.

literal: Earlier Liang general Wang Lin had been defeated by Chen troops, escorting his lord Xiao Zhuang back to Shouyang; the court made Lin inspector of Yangzhou and ordered Qian together with Lin to conduct southern-campaign strategy.
idiomatic: Earlier Liang general Wang Lin had been defeated by Chen troops and escorted his lord Xiao Zhuang back to Shouyang. The court made Lin inspector of Yangzhou and ordered Qian together with Lin to conduct southern-campaign strategy.

literal: Lin's old troops and adherents were mostly in Yangzhou, adjoining Chen invaders.
idiomatic: Lin's old troops and adherents were mostly in Yangzhou, adjoining Chen invaders.

literal: Qian brought internal and external into harmony and deeply won the border people's accord.
idiomatic: Qian brought internal and external affairs into harmony and deeply won the border people's accord.

literal: Chen inspectors of Qin and Qiao prefectures Wang Fengguo and of He prefecture Zhou Lingzhen invaded in succession; Qian at once defeated and pacified them; for merit he was given added rank as scattered-cavalry regular attendant with salary from Pengcheng commandery dry fief.
idiomatic: Chen inspectors of Qin and Qiao prefectures Wang Fengguo and of He prefecture Zhou Lingzhen invaded in succession; Qian at once defeated and pacified them. For merit he was given added rank as scattered-cavalry regular attendant with salary from the dry fief of Pengcheng commandery.

literal: He was moved to inspector of He province while continuing as left aide.
idiomatic: He was moved to inspector of He province while continuing as left aide.

literal: He was again made mobile-staff director of the masters of writing; soon he was given acting insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: He was again made mobile-staff director of the masters of writing; soon he was given acting insignia equal to the three excellencies.

literal: Wang Lin was keen to scheme south; Qian thought the times were not yet ripe.
idiomatic: Wang Lin was keen to scheme south; Qian thought the times were not yet ripe.

literal: It happened that Chen sent a letter to Shouyang requesting peace and harmony with the state.
idiomatic: It happened that Chen sent a letter to Shouyang requesting peace and harmony with the state.

literal: Qian memorialized the report and also submitted a memorial wishing to cease arms.
idiomatic: Qian memorialized the report and also submitted a memorial wishing to cease arms.

literal: As requested.
idiomatic: As requested.

literal: Because of this he and Lin were at odds, mutually impeaching each other in memorials.
idiomatic: Because of this he and Lin were at odds and mutually impeached each other in memorials.

literal: Gao Zhan recalled Lin to the capital and made Qian inspector of Yangzhou, still holding mobile-staff director of the masters of writing.
idiomatic: Gao Zhan recalled Lin to the capital and made Qian inspector of Yangzhou, still holding mobile-staff director of the masters of writing.

literal: Qian was in Huainan thirteen years, in overall charge of army and people, planting great achievements; Chen men deeply feared him.
idiomatic: Qian was in Huainan thirteen years, in overall charge of army and people, and planted great achievements; Chen men deeply feared him.

literal: The Chen ruler wrote his frontier generals: "Lu Qian is still at Shouyang—heard when will he return north? While this captive is not dead he will be a national calamity; you ought to guard deeply against him."
idiomatic: The Chen ruler wrote his frontier generals, "Lu Qian is still at Shouyang—when will he return north? While this captive is not dead he will be a national calamity; you ought to guard deeply against him."

literal: At the beginning when Gao Yang pacified Huainan he granted ten years of privileged exemption from levies.
idiomatic: At the beginning, when Gao Yang pacified Huainan, he granted ten years of privileged exemption from levies.

literal: After the term ended, by the Tiantong and Wuping eras taxation grew numerous and complex.
idiomatic: After the term ended, by the Tiantong and Wuping eras taxation grew numerous and complex.

literal: Moreover Gao Yuanhai held power and prohibited fishing and hunting so households had no means to support themselves.
idiomatic: Moreover Gao Yuanhai held power and prohibited fishing and hunting, so households had no means to support themselves.

literal: Various merchant Hu who owed official interest were allowed by eunuch Chen Dexin arbitrarily to register the debts against wealthy families of Huainan and order prefectures and counties to collect payment.
idiomatic: Various merchant Hu who owed official interest were allowed by eunuch Chen Dexin arbitrarily to register the debts against wealthy Huainan families and order prefectures and counties to collect payment.

literal: There was also an edict to send several thousand Turkish horses into Yangzhou's jurisdiction and order local magnates to buy them at high price.
idiomatic: There was also an edict to send several thousand Turkish horses into Yangzhou's jurisdiction and order local magnates to buy them at high price.

literal: The money had scarcely entered when an edict came to seize horses throughout the Jiang and Huai region and send them all to the government stables.
idiomatic: The money had scarcely entered when an edict came to seize horses throughout the Jiang and Huai region and send them all to the government stables.

literal: Because of this the common people were disturbed; they gnashed teeth and sighed in resentment.
idiomatic: Because of this the common people were disturbed; they gnashed their teeth and sighed in resentment.

literal: Qian according to circumstances comforted them and also employed expedient strategy, and therefore attained peace.
idiomatic: Qian according to circumstances comforted them and also employed expedient strategy, and therefore attained peace.

literal: In the third Wuping year he was summoned as director of the five armies ministry.
idiomatic: In the third Wuping year he was summoned as director of the five armies ministry.

literal: Yangzhou officials and people, because Qian strictly avoided wine and meat and devoutly believed in Buddhism, held a great Buddhist assembly, with incense and flowers lining the road, and sent him off weeping.
idiomatic: Yangzhou officials and people, because Qian strictly avoided wine and meat and devoutly believed in Buddhism, held a great Buddhist assembly, with incense and flowers lining the road, and sent him off weeping.

literal: Qian sighed: "I fear not long before I return."
idiomatic: Qian sighed, "I fear not long before I return."

literal: At Ye not many days had passed when Chen general Wu Mingche crossed the river invading; Qian was again made Yangzhou-circuit mobile-staff director of the masters of writing.
idiomatic: At Ye, not many days had passed when Chen general Wu Mingche crossed the river invading; Qian was again made Yangzhou-circuit mobile-staff director of the masters of writing.

literal: In the fifth year he fell together with Wang Lin and the rest.
idiomatic: In the fifth year he fell together with Wang Lin and the rest.

literal: Soon he died at Jianye, aged fifty-seven.
idiomatic: Soon he died at Jianye, aged fifty-seven.

literal: His family ransomed the corpse to return for burial.
idiomatic: His family ransomed the corpse to return it for burial.

literal: Posthumously enfeoffed as grand master opening the government with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies, right vice director of the masters of writing, and inspector of Yan province.
idiomatic: Posthumously enfeoffed as grand master opening the government with protocol equal to the three excellencies, right vice director of the masters of writing, and inspector of Yan province.

literal: Having no sons, he took his younger brother Shisui's son Yuanxiao as heir.
idiomatic: Having no sons, he took his younger brother Shisui's son Yuanxiao as heir.

literal: Shisui, styled Ziyan, in youth was known to Cui Ang; Ang said: "These brothers are enough to be outstanding men of the younger generation—only a pity they do not read books at all."
idiomatic: Shisui, styled Ziyan, in youth was known to Cui Ang. Ang said, "These brothers are enough to be outstanding men of the younger generation—only a pity they do not read books at all."

literal: He served in succession as attendant censor, libationer of the ministry of worship, gentleman of the masters of writing, magistrate of Ye county, left and right vice directors of the masters of writing, director in the ministry of personnel; went out as administrator of Zhongshan, concurrently chief administrator of Ding province.
idiomatic: He served in succession as attendant censor, libationer of the ministry of worship, gentleman of the masters of writing, magistrate of Ye county, left and right vice directors of the masters of writing, and director in the ministry of personnel; he went out as administrator of Zhongshan, concurrently chief administrator of Ding province.

literal: After Qi fell he died.
idiomatic: After Qi fell he died.

literal: Qian's second cousin Huainian, styled Ziyou, was son of Wei secretariat marshal Daojiang.
idiomatic: Qian's second cousin Huainian, styled Ziyou, was son of Wei secretariat marshal Daojiang.

literal: Huainian was broadly learned with literary accomplishment; his nature was calm and quiet, often bearing an air of leisurely detachment.
idiomatic: Huainian was broadly learned with literary accomplishment; his nature was calm and quiet, often bearing an air of leisurely detachment.

literal: He served as recorder for the grand commandant and as administrator of Hongnong but did not take up the post, choosing residence on the border of Chenliu.
idiomatic: He served as recorder for the grand commandant and as administrator of Hongnong but did not take up the post, choosing residence on the border of Chenliu.

literal: His writings in poetry, fu, eulogy, and hymn exceeded twenty thousand words; he also compiled Records of Kindred Excellence in twenty scrolls.
idiomatic: His writings in poetry, fu, eulogy, and hymn exceeded twenty thousand words; he also compiled Records of Kindred Excellence in twenty scrolls.

literal: Huainian had conduct and probity and was good at friendship; with Langye Wang Yan and Longxi Li Shou he was deeply close.
idiomatic: Huainian had conduct and probity and was good at friendship; with Langye Wang Yan and Longxi Li Shou he was deeply close.

literal: He once told Yan: "In antiquity Taichiu's way was broad yet Xu Shao knew him and would not look at him;
idiomatic: He once told Yan, "In antiquity Taichiu's way was broad yet Xu Shao knew him and would not look at him;

literal: Ji's nature was indolent yet Zhong Hui passed by and broke off speech with him.
idiomatic: Ji's nature was indolent yet Zhong Hui passed by and broke off speech with him.

literal: I stand between Chi and Meng and have removed their excesses."
idiomatic: I stand between Chi and Meng and have removed their excesses."

literal: Yan thought it so.
idiomatic: Yan thought it so.

literal: He died late in Wuping.
idiomatic: He died late in Wuping.

literal: Huainian's elder brother's son Zhuangzhi in youth had name and repute.
idiomatic: Huainian's elder brother's son Zhuangzhi in youth had name and repute.

literal: He held office as crown-prince gentleman attendant, separate aide of Ding province, administrator of Dongping.
idiomatic: He held office as crown-prince gentleman attendant, separate aide of Ding province, and administrator of Dongping.

literal: Late in Wuping he was commissioner of waterways; he died in office.
idiomatic: Late in Wuping he was commissioner of waterways; he died in office.

literal: Huainian's younger cousin from father's line Changheng was son of Wei left vice director of the masters of writing Daogian.
idiomatic: Huainian's younger cousin from his father's line Changheng was son of Wei left vice director of the masters of writing Daogian.

literal: Late in Wuping he was gentleman of the masters of writing.
idiomatic: Late in Wuping he was gentleman of the masters of writing.

literal: Calm and quiet with talent and insight, bearing and manner well contained, deportment worth viewing.
idiomatic: Calm and quiet with talent and insight, bearing and manner well contained, deportment worth viewing.

literal: In the Tianbao era Minister of Writing Wang Xin was condemned for elegant talk; his younger brothers still maintained it but thereafter this way suddenly declined.
idiomatic: In the Tianbao era minister of writing Wang Xin was condemned for elegant talk; his younger brothers still maintained it, but thereafter this way suddenly declined.

literal: Changheng together with Dunqiu Li Ruo, Pengcheng Liu Taizhen, Henan Lu Yanshi, Longxi Xin Deyuan, and Taiyuan Wang Xiu were all leading younger-generation men of grace and fashion.
idiomatic: Changheng together with Dunqiu Li Ruo, Pengcheng Liu Taizhen, Henan Lu Yanshi, Longxi Xin Deyuan, and Taiyuan Wang Xiu were all leading younger-generation men of grace and fashion.

literal: Changheng's younger cousin from father's line Sidao was son of Wei unreclused Daoliang; his spirit and expression were brilliant, and from youth he had great fame for talent and learning.
idiomatic: Changheng's younger cousin from his father's line Sidao was son of Wei unreclused Daoliang; his spirit and expression were brilliant, and from youth he had great fame for talent and learning.

literal: Late in Wuping he was vice director of the yellow gate and awaited edicts at the Forest of Literature Hall.
idiomatic: Late in Wuping he was vice director of the yellow gate and awaited edicts at the Forest of Literature Hall.

literal: Sidao's elder cousins from father's line Zhengda, Zhengsi, and Zhengshan were sons of Wei right director of the shining grandee Daoyue.
idiomatic: Sidao's elder cousins from his father's line Zhengda, Zhengsi, and Zhengshan were sons of Wei right director of the shining grandee Daoyue.

literal: Zhengda was gentleman of the masters of writing; Zhengsi was inspector of Northern Xuzhou, crown-prince grand tutor, equal in insignia to the Three Excellencies; Zhengshan was administrator of Yongchang commandery.
idiomatic: Zhengda was gentleman of the masters of writing; Zhengsi was inspector of Northern Xuzhou, crown-prince grand tutor, and equal in insignia to the three excellencies; Zhengshan was administrator of Yongchang commandery.

literal: The brothers because they were maternal uncles of the emperor in Wuping all received preferential posthumous enfeoffments.
idiomatic: The brothers, because they were maternal uncles of the emperor, in Wuping all received preferential posthumous enfeoffments.
